results.title: General Manager – Logistics Stockyard (Automotive)
results.description: The Job Summary The General Manager leads Petromin Logistics' stockyard as a profitable, customer-focused and technology-driven automotive logistics business. The role owns the full P&L, acquires and retains vehicle-brand accounts, and delivers reliable service across the vehicle lifecycle, driving the stockyard's launch and growth through digital operations, financial discipline and continuous improvement. Key Performance Indicators / Measures: • Revenue, operating profit and cash flow vs. the approved business plan • Customer margin, cost per vehicle and capacity utilisation • New vehicle-brand accounts won and growth of existing accounts • Customer satisfaction, retention and SLA achievement • Vehicle turnaround, dispatch reliability and PDI first-time-right • Damage, rework and claims recovery • Digital and AI use cases delivered, with measured gains in productivity, accuracy and cost • Safety, quality and business-continuity performance; team capability The KPIs listed in this JD define what the role is measured on; specific targets and weights are set and may be adjusted annually through the performance management cycle, in agreement with the line manager. Technical / Job-Specific Competencies 1 Business Plan & P&L Ownership Own the stockyard business plan, budget and P&L, and drive pricing, cost control, billing and collections, to deliver revenue, profit and cash targets. 2 Profitability & Investment Manage profitability by customer and service, cost per vehicle and break-even utilisation, and build investment cases for capacity and technology, to secure measurable returns. 3 Strategic Account Acquisition Personally lead account acquisition with Business Development, winning OEM, vehicle-brand, importer and distributor business through strong relationships and competitive proposals, to grow and diversify revenue. 4 Contracts & Account Growth Negotiate contracts and service levels with Finance and Legal, and grow existing accounts in line with operational capacity, to secure profitable, sustainable business. 5 Digital Strategy & Systems Lead the stockyard's digital strategy, integrating YMS, ERP, transport and customer systems, to give real-time vehicle visibility, accurate inventory and digital workflows. 6 AI & Automation Adoption Prioritise and implement AI and automation for capacity planning, vehicle allocation, damage detection, predictive maintenance and reporting, with Corporate IT ensuring data quality, security and responsible AI use, to lower cost and raise productivity. 7 Stockyard Launch & Operations Lead readiness, launch and daily operations across receipt, storage, stock preservation, PDI, VAS, customs coordination and dispatch, and control outsourced service performance, to run a reliable, efficient stockyard. 8 Customer Experience & SLAs Deliver customer SLAs, resolve escalations and improve turnaround, productivity and vehicle condition through standard procedures and root-cause problem-solving, to raise satisfaction and retention. 9 People Leadership Develop accountable managers and digitally capable teams, and align workforce capacity and shared-service levels with business needs, to deliver the business plan. 10 Safety, Quality & Governance Own safety, quality, vehicle custody and business continuity, oversee damage prevention and claims recovery, and strengthen the Integrated Management System, reporting performance and risks to the CEO, to protect people, vehicles and the business. The Job Profile 1 Educational Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration or a related discipline. An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred. 2 Professional Certifications No mandatory certification. A logistics or supply chain certification (e.g., ASCM CLTD / CSCP, CILT) is an advantage. 3 Experience 15+ years of relevant experience, including 5 years in senior leadership with direct P&L accountability; Saudi or GCC experience is preferred. 4 Essential Job Pre-Requisites Strong finished-vehicle logistics experience (stockyard operations, PDI, transportation, outsourced services), including launching or substantially improving a stockyard or comparable operation. Proven personal success winning and retaining OEM, importer, distributor or major logistics accounts. Demonstrated delivery of YMS, WMS, TMS or ERP integration or comparable digital transformation, with measurable results. 5 Languages Proficiency Fluency in English and Arabic is mandatory.

results.title: Head of Passenger Services(Railway/Metro Transportation)
results.description: At Terracotta Outsourcing , we drive business growth through recruitment, manpower outsourcing, visa outsourcing, EOR/PEO, payroll, PRO services, business setup, and corporate solutions across the UAE. We are seeking an experienced Head of Passenger Services – Metro on behalf of a confidential client within the UAE's transportation sector. This senior leadership position will oversee the planning, development, and management of passenger services operations, ensuring the delivery of safe, reliable, efficient, and customer-focused metro services. Location: Dubai, UAE Industry: Rail / Metro Operations Employment Type: Full-Time The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in metro or rail operations, strong leadership capabilities, and a proven track record in managing station operations, frontline teams, and passenger service performance. Key Responsibilities Lead the strategic planning, development, and overall management of the Metro Passenger Services Department. Oversee station operations, staffing, and resource allocation to ensure safe and efficient service delivery. Manage the recruitment, deployment, performance, and development of station managers, supervisors, and frontline personnel. Ensure operational readiness across stations, including staffing, service standards, and safety requirements. Monitor departmental KPIs and implement initiatives to improve operational efficiency and passenger satisfaction. Coordinate closely with Train Operations, Operations Control Centre (OCC), depot operations, and other departments. Oversee incident response, operational investigations, and the implementation of corrective and preventive actions. Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), operational guidelines, and work instructions. Lead staff competency development, training initiatives, and continuous improvement programmes. Promote a strong culture of safety, operational excellence, accountability, and customer service. Qualifications & Experience: Bachelor's degree or higher diploma in a relevant discipline. Minimum 10–12 years of relevant professional experience , preferably within metro, rail, or mass transit operations. At least 5 years of leadership experience managing station operations, passenger services, or customer-facing teams within the transportation sector. Strong understanding of metro station operations, train operations, depot activities, staff rostering, and OCC interfaces. Proven ability to manage large operational teams and deliver against service performance targets. Strong knowledge of passenger safety, incident management, operational procedures, and service quality standards. Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Experience in GCC metro or rail operations is highly advantageous. Passenger train driver certification and experience with training and assessment programmes are desirable. How to Apply If you are an experienced Metro or Rail Operations professional ready to take on a senior leadership opportunity in the UAE, we encourage you to apply. Apply directly through Terracotta Outsourcing for confidential consideration.

results.title: Transportation Supervisor
results.description: About the Role We are looking for an experienced Transport Supervisor to oversee and coordinate daily transportation operations between the Distribution Center (DC) and assigned dark store locations across Kuwait . The role will be responsible for ensuring the timely and efficient movement of goods from the DC to dark stores, managing delivery routes and schedules, overseeing truck fleet operations and utilization , monitoring driver performance, and maintaining high standards of operational efficiency and service quality. The Transport Supervisor will also be responsible for route planning and optimization, delivery allocation, truck fleet management, vehicle utilization and availability, driver coordination, transportation performance tracking, and managing operational issues and delays . The role will work closely with DC and dark store teams to ensure smooth and reliable replenishment operations, minimize delivery delays, optimize transportation resources, and ensure that dark stores receive the required inventory on time. Key Responsibilities Manage daily transportation operations from the Distribution Center (DC) to assigned dark store locations , ensuring timely, safe, and efficient movement of goods and smooth execution of replenishment plans. Plan, coordinate, and optimize transport routes, delivery schedules, truck allocation, and delivery capacity based on business requirements, store demand, and operational priorities. Manage and monitor the truck fleet , including vehicle availability, utilization, deployment, maintenance coordination, and overall fleet efficiency. Coordinate and supervise drivers and transport teams , ensuring adherence to delivery schedules, assigned routes, operational procedures, safety requirements, and service standards. Monitor daily transportation performance and key KPIs, including on-time delivery, route efficiency, vehicle utilization, delivery turnaround time, transportation costs, and service quality . Track deliveries in real time, identify delays, route deviations, vehicle issues, and other transportation exceptions, and take timely corrective actions to minimize operational disruptions. Coordinate closely with DC, dark store, warehouse, operations, and other relevant teams to ensure accurate loading, dispatch, receiving, and timely replenishment of dark stores. Identify, investigate, and resolve transportation-related operational issues and delivery exceptions, conducting root-cause analysis and implementing corrective and preventive actions. Analyze transportation data and operational trends to identify opportunities for route optimization, fleet utilization, cost reduction, and process improvement . Ensure compliance with company transportation policies, fleet safety standards, vehicle requirements, driver procedures, and applicable local regulations . Oversee the training and development of drivers and transport team members, ensuring they have the required operational knowledge, safety awareness, and service standards. Prepare regular transportation performance reports and provide data-driven insights and recommendations to management on fleet performance, route efficiency, operational issues, and improvement opportunities. Support the development and continuous optimization of transportation processes, route planning, fleet management, and DC-to-dark-store delivery operations to improve efficiency, reliability, and overall service quality. Job Requirements Bachelor's degree or higher in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration , or a related field; alternatively, 3+ years of relevant experience in transport, logistics, or delivery operations . Proven experience in delivery, transport, logistics, fleet, preferably within a fast-paced e-commerce or delivery environment. Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret operational data and identify performance improvement opportunities. Strong execution and follow-up skills, with the ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Good project management and process improvement capabilities. Fluent in English , with strong written and verbal communication skills. Willingness to be based in Kuwait and work according to operational requirements, including flexible working hours when necessary.

results.title: Sr. Manager Logistics Operations
results.description: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description WHAT’S ON YOUR PLATE? Lead Talabat Qatar’s overall supply ecosystem, ensuring a sustainable, high-quality, and high-performing rider base across the country. Develop and execute the overall supply growth and acquisition strategy aligned with business demand and market dynamics. Lead long-term supply forecasting and planning to ensure full coverage and service level adherence. Identify and launch new supply channels such as female riders, refugees, micro-financing, and e-bikes to diversify and sustain fleet growth. Manage the full lifecycle of 3PL partnerships, from selection and onboarding to performance management and contract renewals. Set clear KPIs and SLAs for 3PL partners, ensuring compliance, efficiency, and rider quality. Build and maintain strong strategic relationships with key 3PL partners to drive alignment and operational excellence. Lead and manage the on-ground operations team to ensure smooth daily operations, compliance, and service quality. Monitor and improve key operational KPIs including rider supply rate, EPH, order-on-time percentage, and churn rate. Implement standardized processes and digital tools to enhance control, visibility, and scalability across operations. Coach and develop a high-performing team of managers, seniors, and specialists across supply, 3PLs, and operations. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team. Work closely with cross-functional teams such as People, Finance, Commercial, and Product to align on strategies and deliverables. Identify and implement process improvements and best practices to enhance efficiency and rider satisfaction. Drive automation and technology-enabled initiatives to improve visibility and performance management. Oversee equipment management including uniforms, delivery boxes, and e-bikes to ensure consistent quality and operational standards. Ensure adherence to performance KPIs such as supply run rate, rider churn and retention, 3PL compliance, rider NPS, EPH, and operational coverage. Build long-term plans to sustain growth and strengthen Talabat’s market leadership position. Qualifications WHAT DID WE ORDER? Bachelor’s degree required, with a preference for majors in Logistics, Supply Chain, Operations, or equivalent work experience in compliance or auditing Minimum of 5 years of experience in operational roles within fast-paced environments. Track record in the FoodTech logistics sector is a plus. Management consulting experience is also considered a significant advantage Management experience is advantageous, with the ability to effectively manage direct reports and foster a strong team culture. Strong problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to dig into detail, manage complexity, and drive decision-making Advanced proficiency in GSheet, demonstrating a strong analytical skill set. Ability to reason analytically, logically, and in a consistent fashion Strong English written and verbal communication skills, capable of engaging across a diverse set of stakeholders, Arabic is good to have but not necessary Extremely organized and process-driven, with a proven ability to manage a heavy workload effectively by setting priorities and managing expectations well Able to travel to all talabat markets as needed.

results.title: Divisional Operations Manager- Road Transport
results.description: 📢📢📢 We are looking for a Divisional Operations Manager- Road Transport (RT) Operations, based in Riyadh. JOB PURPOSE: To lead and oversee the overall RT operations across assigned locations, ensuring safe, efficient, reliable, and cost-effective operations through optimum fleet and manpower utilization, effective fleet availability and maintenance coordination, fuel and tyre cost control, strong safety culture, customer satisfaction, operational visibility, and continuous improvement, while achieving business objectives and agreed KPIs. To ensure that safety and environmental aspects of Sustainability are embedded into the business strategy and daily operations. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 1. Fleet Utilization & Availability Monitor fleet utilization on a daily basis and identify opportunities for improvement. Conduct daily fleet availability checks and coordinate with Maintenance to minimize vehicle downtime. Monitor fleet running kilometres on daily basis and control unnecessary or excess running. 2. Driver Management & Utilization Monitor driver availability and utilization on a daily basis. Plan and manage driver scheduling to ensure optimum utilization and minimize idle time. Ensure adequate driver availability to meet daily customer requirements. 3. Fuel Management & Cost Reduction Monitor fuel mileage/consumption and implement actions to improve mileage. Investigate abnormal fuel consumption and take corrective action. Control unnecessary vehicle running and identify opportunities for fuel cost reduction. 4. Tyre Management Monitor tyre utilization, replacement and performance. Implement effective controls to maximize tyre life and reduce tyre-related costs. Coordinate with Maintenance for timely inspection and corrective action. 5. Safety & Compliance Drive a strong safety culture across the driver and RT Operations teams with hearts and minds approach. Monitor driver safety performance and ensure compliance with company safety standards. Take proactive action to address unsafe practices and recurring safety concerns. Conduct enroute spot checks and reporting. Conduct pre-loading and vehicle & integrity checks. Incident reporting and participation in Incident investigation. 6. Customer Management Maintain close coordination with customers regarding daily orders and operational requirements. Ensure timely follow-up and resolution of customer requirements and operational issues. Maintain strong customer relationships and improve service satisfaction. Increase the revenues by increased truck utilization. 7. Maintenance Coordination Work closely with the Maintenance team to improve fleet availability and reliability. Support initiatives to reduce maintenance costs and improve preventive maintenance practices. Monitor recurring vehicle issues and ensure appropriate corrective actions are implemented. 8. Continuous Improvement Identify and implement new initiatives to improve operational efficiency, productivity and cost effectiveness. Establish appropriate KPIs and provide management with clear visibility of operational performance. Continuously review processes and identify opportunities for improvement. 9. Overall RT Operations Management Take overall responsibility for RT Operations at the assigned location. Preparation of daily, weekly and monthly reports and sharing with the stakeholders Participation in customer engagements and BPR Ensure daily operations are properly planned, controlled and executed. Monitor operational performance and take timely corrective action where required. Ensure alignment between Operations, Drivers, Maintenance, Customers and Management. Follow-up for Customer payments
